tools.description: Analyze thousands of a game's reviews: sentiment over time, by language, playtime, Deck, key vs Steam purchase, dev replies.

cursor.description: Resume from a previous result's next_cursor; '*' (default) starts at the newest review.

day_range.description: Only reviews from the last N days (1-3650); the scan stops at that edge. Omit to go back as far as max_reviews allows.

language.description: A Steam language name (e.g. 'english'), or 'all' (default) to include every language and break them down.

max_reviews.description: Reviews to analyze, newest first (100-20000). Every 100 is one request to Steam, so 20000 takes a minute or two.

purchase_type.description: 'all' (default, so Steam purchases and key activations can be compared), 'steam', or 'store' (the store page's population).

samples.description: Example reviews kept per group: newest and most helpful, positive and negative (0-5).

tools.name: steam_analyze_app_reviews

tools.description: Analyze a whole game library: backlog, playtime distribution, abandoned games.

abandoned_limit.description: How many 'abandoned' games to list (0-100). Independent of backlog_limit; ordered by abandoned_sort.

abandoned_sort.description: Order for the abandoned list: 'recent' (most recently dropped first — the most actionable to resume), 'oldest' (longest-dropped first), or 'playtime' (most hours sunk first).

backlog_limit.description: How many never-played games to list (0-100). Defaults to the max so 'what should I play' sees the whole backlog, not an alphabetical slice of it.

exclude_temp_clients.description: Exclude non-retail clients (betas, playtests, demos, trials, test servers, staging branches, prototypes) — they're often unlaunchable, so they pollute 'what to play next'. Detected by name; the excluded count is always reported. Set false to include them in every stat and list.

stale_days.description: A played game untouched for at least this many days is counted as 'abandoned' (30-3650).

steamid.description: SteamID64, vanity name, or profile URL of the library owner. Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER, if set.

top_limit.description: How many most-played games to list (1-50).

tools.name: steam_analyze_library

annotations.title: Compare Steam Games Side by Side

tools.description: Compare 2-5 games side by side — price, reviews and their trend, players now, Deck, co-op, tags — for "X or Y?" questions.

appids.description: 2-5 appids to compare side by side (resolve names with steam_search_apps first).

tools.name: steam_compare_games

tools.description: Compare two users' libraries: shared games and who has played each more.

limit.description: Max shared games to list, ordered by combined playtime (1-100).

steamid_a.description: First user: SteamID64, vanity name, or profile URL. Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER, if set.

steamid_b.description: Second user: SteamID64, vanity name, or profile URL.

tools.name: steam_compare_players

tools.description: Discover games by criteria — tags, max price, on-sale, platform — optionally personalized to a user's taste; for filter-based search, not "games like X" (use steam_recommend for that).

exclude_owned.description: When steamid is set, hide games the user already owns.

limit.description: Max results to return (1-50).

max_price.description: Maximum price in the country's currency units (e.g. 30 = $30 for country_code='us'). Omit for any price.

released_within_days.description: Only include games released in the last N days, ordered by `sort` within that window. Use for 'what came out recently' or 'well-reviewed games from the last year'. Omit for any release date.

steamid.description: Optional. If set, personalize: seed tags from this user's most-played + recently-played games and (by default) exclude games they own. SteamID64, vanity name, or profile URL.

tags.description: Community tag names to require (AND), e.g. ['Roguelike', 'Co-op']. Resolved to Steam tag IDs; unknown names are reported and ignored.

tools.name: steam_discover

annotations.title: Find Friends Who Own a Game

tools.description: List which of a user's friends own (or are playing) a specific game — "who can I play X with" (about friends' libraries, not store search).

appid.description: The game (appid) to check friends' ownership of.

limit.description: Max owners to list (1-100).

max_friends.description: How many friends to check for ownership (1-250). Each is one concurrent owned-games lookup; raise for completeness, lower for speed.

playing_now.description: If true, list only friends currently in-game in this title now.

steamid.description: The user whose friends to check: SteamID64, vanity, or URL. Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER, if set.

tools.name: steam_find_friends_who_own

tools.description: Get comprehensive store details for a game — the best 'tell me about X' tool.

include_long_description.description: Include the full 'about the game' text (large). Off by default; the short description is always included.

include_requirements.description: Include a short PC system-requirements summary (minimum + recommended).

language.description: Steam language name for localized text (name, description, requirements), e.g. 'english', 'french', 'schinese'. Not ISO codes.

tools.name: steam_get_app_details

tools.description: Get recent news/update posts for a game (patch notes, announcements).
tools.name: steam_get_app_news

tools.description: Compare a game's price across regions (each in its own local currency).

countries.description: ISO country codes to price in (2 letters each, max 20). Prices are returned in each region's own currency.

tools.name: steam_get_app_regional_pricing

tools.description: Get the review score and sample reviews for a game (lifetime and/or recent).

day_range.description: Window in days for review_filter='recent' (1-365). Ignored when review_filter='all'. Default 30 to match Steam's store page.

language.description: Review language to include and score: a Steam language name (e.g. 'english', 'french') or 'all' for every language. Default 'english'.

limit.description: Number of individual review excerpts to include (0-20). The score summary is always returned.

purchase_type.description: Whose reviews count: 'store' (default) matches the store page (Steam purchases only for a paid game, excluding key activations; everyone for a free game); 'steam' or 'all' to force either.

recent_max_reviews.description: Fallback only: most reviews to count for review_filter='recent' if Steam refuses the exact count (100-10000).

review_filter.description: Scoring window: 'all' returns Steam's lifetime summary; 'recent' additionally computes the last-N-days score (the store page's 'Recent Reviews' box) by tallying the newest reviews. Default 'all'.

review_type.description: Which reviews to sample for excerpts: 'all', 'positive', or 'negative'.

tools.name: steam_get_app_reviews

tools.description: Get a game's top community tags (Souls-like, Roguelike, Cozy, …) by weight.

limit.description: Max tags to return, ordered by community weight (1-50).

tools.name: steam_get_app_tags

tools.description: Get the number of players currently in-game for a title (live concurrency).
tools.name: steam_get_current_players

tools.description: Steam Deck rating for a game: Verified, Playable, Unsupported, or Unknown.

language.description: Steam language name for the report (the category label is normalized to English regardless).

tools.name: steam_get_deck_compatibility

tools.description: List a game's DLC (add-ons), optionally with live prices and sale status.

appid.description: Steam application (game) ID of the BASE game whose DLC to list.

enrich.description: Fetch each DLC's name + current price/discount (one store lookup per DLC, run concurrently). Set false for a fast appid-only list.

limit.description: Max DLC entries to return (1-100). Big franchises list hundreds of DLC, so keep this modest when enriching.

on_sale_only.description: If true (requires enrich=true), return only DLC currently discounted.

tools.name: steam_get_dlc

tools.description: List games currently ON SALE (featured specials) on the Steam store.

country_code.description: ISO country code for regional pricing (e.g. 'us', 'gb', 'de').

limit.description: Max games on sale to return (1-50).

tools.description: List a user's Steam friends, enriched with name and current status.

online_only.description: If true, return only friends who are not Offline.

steamid.description: SteamID64 (17 digits), vanity name, or full profile URL (e.g. '76561197960287930', 'gabelogannewell'). Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER (your own Steam name), if set.

tools.description: List a user's Steam inventory — game items or generic Community items.

appid.description: App whose inventory to read. 753 = Steam Community items (trading cards, emoticons, backgrounds, gems); 730 = CS2; 440 = TF2; 570 = Dota 2; etc.

context_id.description: Inventory context within the app. Leave unset to auto-pick (6 for app 753 / Community items, 2 for games).

count.description: Max item instances to fetch (a sample for very large inventories).

language.description: Steam language name for localized item names.

limit.description: Max distinct items to list, most-numerous first (1-200); distinct_items always counts all of them.

steamid.description: SteamID64, vanity name, or profile URL of the inventory owner. Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER, if set.

tools.name: steam_get_inventory

tools.description: Get the Community Market price for a single item, with rarity and condition.

appid.description: App the item belongs to: 730 = CS2, 440 = TF2, 570 = Dota 2, 753 = Steam Community items.

include_item_details.description: Also look up the item's type/rarity and listing count (one extra request). Set false for price only.

market_hash_name.description: The item's exact Market Hash Name — it encodes the variant, so include condition/quality prefixes, e.g. 'AK-47 | Redline (Field-Tested)', 'StatTrak™ AWP | Asiimov (Field-Tested)', 'Souvenir ...'. Copy it from the item's Community Market page.

steamid.description: SteamID64 (17 digits), vanity name, or full profile URL (e.g. '76561197960287930', 'gabelogannewell'). Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER (your own Steam name), if set.

tools.description: Find co-op games the host and their friends all own — for game night.

friends.description: Optional explicit group (SteamID64s / vanity names) — pass this to plan with specific people. If omitted, uses the host's friends (online ones by default).

limit.description: Max co-op games to list.

max_friends.description: Max friends to check when deriving the group (bounds lookups).

min_friends_owning.description: A game must be owned by the host AND at least this many group members to be suggested.

mode.description: 'owned' (default): co-op games the host + friends already SHARE, ranked by how many own each. 'new': well-reviewed co-op games NONE of the group owns yet — fresh picks to buy and play together.

online_only.description: When the group is derived from the friend list, include only friends online right now. Ignored when 'friends' is given.

steamid.description: The host whose library to match against friends. SteamID64, vanity, or profile URL. Omit to use the configured STEAM_USER, if set.

tools.description: Recommend games similar to a seed game ("like Hades") or to a user's taste, explaining the shared tags; for "games like X" / "what should I play" (for filtered search use steam_discover).

limit.description: Max recommendations (1-30).

seed_appid.description: Recommend games similar to THIS game (by community tags).

steamid.description: Excludes games this user already owns; seeds the tags from their taste (most-played + recent) only when no seed_appid/tags are given. SteamID64, vanity, or profile URL.

tags.description: Explicit tag names to base recommendations on. Takes precedence over seed_appid/steamid tags if given.

query.description: Game title (or partial title) to search for.
